test: K01 fixed rendering preserves only the named properties
note: Named field equality, source presence and exact fixed template pass; prose semantics explicitly remains notChecked.
A changed represented subject fails equality.

test: K03 often becoming always fails modality
note: Often versus always fails exact represented modality equality.

test: K04 explicitly removed circumstances fail equality
note: Known circumstance versus explicit absence fails equality.

test: K05 widening the comparison fails equality
note: A changed represented comparison fails equality.

test: K06 misleading free prose cannot receive a semantic pass
note: Misleading free prose yields changed bytes, an empty represented-property differences list and prose notChecked. Byte inequality is separate from semantic assessment; downstream trust behavior remains untested.

test: K07 unannotated circumstances remain not checked
note: Unknown annotation returns notChecked rather than a false pass or removal finding.

test: K08 edited candidate bytes invalidate receipt
note: Changed candidate bytes produce stale(candidate) despite unchanged fields.

test: K09 same atom ID cannot conceal changed source bytes
note: Changed source bytes under the same atom identity produce stale(source); a fresh quote-presence check detects removal.

test: K10 every declared input component invalidates its binding
note: Separate mutations cover old bytes, annotation, rule definition, rule version, checker version, assumptions and mode; each invalidates the corresponding digest.

test: K11 missing or ineligible sources prevent current checking
note: Deleted/ineligible required sources make source checks notChecked and receipt applicability unavailable. Independently available presentation bytes can still be unchanged; missing old or candidate bytes yield byteChange unavailable.

test: K12 admitted identity remains an explicit assumption
note: The admitted identity claim is exposed on dependent passing properties as conditional. No annotation fidelity is inferred.

test: K13 lost narrative uncertainty remains outside field checking
note: The fixture loses its literal uncertainty sentence while represented fields pass; byteChange reports changed and prose remains unassessed. Independent narrative review/reader behavior is deferred.

test: K14 selection commutes only with field-preserving formatting
note: Finite field-preserving selection/formatting paths commute after normalization; a subject-changing counterexample does not. No truncation or lossy transform is included.

test: K15 faithful free rephrasing has no machine prose guarantee
note: Faithful free prose receives field passes, byteChange changed and prose notChecked. Whether readers accept it appropriately remains behavioral work.

test: K16 matching false annotations expose the semantic boundary
note: The same deliberately false attribution passes preservation, exposing that shared false premises are not detected. Annotation extraction/review performance remains unmeasured.

test: K17 byte limits refuse before source traversal or hashing
note: An oversized input returns unsupported before source traversal; all component text and total canonical bytes are bounded before hashes/property checks.

test: K18 historical failure is separate from present applicability
note: A prior modality failure remains explicitly historical when sources become unavailable; policy suppression takes precedence. Receipts contain no quotes or semantic field values.
